g.title: U1
g.text: D0, D1, D6-D10 and A0: sheet 02.
A1 (BUTTON_ADC): button ladder not documented yet.

g.title: J7
g.text: On board: 10 kOhm pull-ups on XSHUT and GPIO1,
2.2 kOhm I2C pull-ups via solder bridges SB2/SB4.

g.title: J9
g.text: 2.8 in SPI TFT, ILI9341, touch version (MSP2807)
J1 is open (checked 2026-11-21): VCC on 5 V from Nano VBUS,
through the module's own 3.3 V regulator. Never bridge J1 while
VCC is on 5 V. Logic stays 3.3 V.
LED drives the backlight transistor: on 3.3 V = always on.
SDO/MISO not connected. Touch pins 10-14 (separate touch SPI,
XPT2046 on the module): touch not used, not connected.

g.title: U4
g.text: Regulated 3.3 V into J4-5 (SparkFun hookup guide).
Do not plug in its USB-C at the same time.

g.title: J12
g.text: Phase A pulled up to 3.3 V by the Nano's
Phase B and Z not used: insulate.

g.title: J13
g.text: Phase B and Z not used: insulate.
